prompt: Use the supplied reference video as the strict composition, appearance and overlay-motion reference. Produce a ten-second variation changing ONLY the motion of the four existing people. This is the settled Paris scene's quiet idle animation, NOT a construction or loading sequence. Preserve the original locked camera, architecture, café furniture, lamps, sign, pavement fragments, black surround, blue/magenta/off-white point and glyph overlay animation, two upper-right detail panes and all typography. Do not freeze or replace the existing overlay motion. Keep the same four people, appearances, clothing, scale and depth ordering. Animate the foreground hand-holding pair with two or three small, slow, natural steps along their existing crossing direction over the shot; their total travel must remain modest and inside the central foreground. Feet alternately plant and lift with heel-to-toe contact, knees and hips bend coherently, weight transfers naturally; no sliding or walking in place. Their joined hands stay connected, free arms swing gently, cloth follows the bodies subtly. Do not reverse gait to return to the first pose. For the two farther people near the café, add distinct restrained life: one takes a small slow step toward the entrance, the other makes a subtle weight shift and slight head/shoulder turn. Keep their rear-facing orientation and do not invent facial details. Preserve the sparse/dithered material treatment on bodies while articulating it with them rather than dissolving anatomy. No extra people, duplicated limbs, teleportation, melting, foot skating, floating, body flicker, camera movement, new scene elements, moved furniture, changed labels, new panels, recoloring, added bloom or audio. Do not add tracking graphics across faces or hands. Keep all four figures identifiable throughout. Output one continuous silent shot. Seamless looping is not required; prioritize coherent forward movement and a calm ending over a forced pose reset.

inspection.method: Read of eleven full-scene samples at integer seconds 0–10, sixteen foreground crops at 0.25-second intervals from 0–3.75 seconds, and full-resolution frame at 5 seconds. Temporal sampling, not continuous real-time playback.
observations: All four people remain visible in inspected scene samples, unlike the Kling edit. Foreground pair retains apparent hand connection with changing leg, foot and free-arm poses.

Foot lift/lower and small stance changes are visible in quarter-second crops, but world-space travel is limited. The gait reads near-in-place rather than a clear continuation of the original diagonal crossing.

Broad cafe, furniture, lamp/sign and right-door composition remains recognizable; point/glyph overlays vary while the outer black surround remains open. No obvious added scene object or cut in sampled frames.
Two rear figures remain, but their requested distinct step and head/shoulder motion are not clearly established at this sampling scale.
Small detail-pane subtitles and other typography have visible distortion. Foreground initial poses/body material rendering differ from the original baseline; pixel-exact preservation is not claimed.
limits: No claim of biomechanically natural or fully artifact-free gait
No exhaustive sub-second flicker or body-topology review
